Description

The Joyce Tote is designed for the woman who refuses to choose between elegance and function. A clean, generously sized silhouette that goes from the office to dinner without ever needing a bag swap.

Its separate lower compartment, accessible through a side zipper, lets you carry a pair of shoes, lunch, or anything you'd rather keep apart. It's the bag's signature feature — and the reason our customers wear it every day.

Sold with an adjustable shoulder strap included.

Specifications
  • Dimensions: 40 cm W × 30 cm H × 16 cm D
  • Weight: 1.1 kg
  • Main compartment: gold zip closure, recycled polyester lining
  • Lower compartment: zippered side access, for shoes or separate items
  • Inner pocket: zippered, for keys, phone, wallet
  • Handles: 24 cm drop, hand or shoulder carry
  • Shoulder strap: adjustable and removable, included
  • Base: protective gold rivets (4 corners)
Materials & Commitment

Exterior: certified vegan leather, made from recycled plastic bottles. No animal materials.

Interior: 100% recycled polyester lining.

Hardware: nickel-free gold metal, hypoallergenic.

Designed in Montréal, made to ethical standards we hold ourselves to personally.

Care

Wipe with a soft, slightly damp cloth. For tougher stains, use a mild pH-neutral soap.

Avoid prolonged exposure to direct sunlight and high heat. Do not machine wash. Store in the included cotton pouch.

Shipping & Returns

Free shipping across Canada, with no minimum purchase. Shipped from Montréal within 48 business hours. Estimated delivery: 2 to 5 days depending on your province.

Free returns within 30 days if the bag isn't right for you. Just send us a note and we'll take care of everything.

The Joyce, from the inside

1:24 · With Janice

The signature

Designed for your double life.

A 4 pm meeting, a 6 pm cocktail. Instead of juggling a second bag, you slide your heels into the Joyce's lower compartment.

Accessible through a side zipper, sealed off from the rest, and lined so it won't stain your things. It's the detail that changes your whole day.

Function

Everything has its place.

A zippered pocket for keys and your phone. A central compartment that holds a 13-inch laptop without shifting. Enough depth for a notebook, a wallet, a makeup bag.

No more digging at a red light. You know exactly where everything is.

Seen on the street

The bag that keeps up the pace,
without ever losing its edge.

"As elegant as an office bag, but without any special care required. It's exactly what I needed."

Quality, down to the detail

Built to last, not to impress.

Four gold rivets under the base protect the leather from the ground. Clean, even stitching, redone until it held without flinching.

These are the details you don't notice right away — but they're why, two years later, the bag is still here.
